options.text: I'm honored to stand before you.
I've traveled a long way to meet you.
This is quite a fortress you have.
What do you make of your enemies?
What do your subjects need most?
Who keeps a castle like this running?
What would you have me do?
How can I serve the crown?

negative: Save the bow. The line remembers what you did to it.
Kings hear flattery all day. Ours arrives with clean hands. Yours are not clean.
You kneel prettily for someone the line counts as a debt.
neutral: Rise. The floor is cold and ceremony wastes heat.
A crown is a helmet that stopped pretending. State your business.
You found the throne. Most find the trenches first.
positive: Stand easy, friend of the line. Kneeling is for mud, and you have carried enough mud.
The quota knows your name kindly. Few can say that.
Sit. The stove is lit. That is the whole of Vostok hospitality, and it is yours.

negative: Protocol admits you. Nothing else about you is admitted.
Your record is open on my desk. Bow if you like; the record does not blink.
Courtesies noted, logged, and set against a ledger you have not balanced.
neutral: You are received. Reception is not endorsement. Proceed.
The crown acknowledges you. Keep your hands visible and your requests brief.
Audience granted. Six minutes. Spend them like arrows.
positive: The realm reads its ledgers, and yours reads well. Welcome.
You are on the short list of names I am pleased to hear announced.
Sector quiet, ledger clean, and a friend at the door. A good morning by any measure.

negative: The tent is open even to the wind that tears it. Enter, wind.
You bow the way a scorpion lowers its tail. I have ruled too long to miss it.
Shade is given freely here. Trust is drawn from a deeper well, and yours is dry.
neutral: Sit in the shade you are offered and want no other. Then we may talk.
A king is a well the whole desert visits. Draw, but mind the rope.
You crossed much sand to stand still before an old man. Speak.
positive: The well rises to meet some visitors. Yours is a name it knows.
Sit close. The desert starves flatterers and feeds friends; you have eaten with us before.
For you the carpet, the coffee, and the truth. All three are rare.

negative: These walls were paid for in winters. You are not owed the tour.
Ask the stones yourself. They talk more freely to strangers than I do.
It stands. It will stand when you are gone. That ends the tour.
neutral: Granite below, snow above, quota between. That is the whole castle.
Every tower cost a company. We name them for the companies, not for the stone.
It is warm in three rooms and honest in all of them.
positive: Come to the window. Everything the fog touches is ours, and the fog works long shifts.
I will show you the old wall. It has held longer than any promise I have made.
The cellars go deeper than the maps admit. So does the stubbornness.

negative: The fortress specifications are classified. Your clearance is the door.
It is a secure facility. Note the emphasis, then note the exit.
Strong walls, stronger records. Both have your measure already.
neutral: Concentric walls, audited stores, drilled watches. The realm is a machine that eats disorder.
Every stone is inventoried. Every inventory is checked. Sleep comes easily here.
The castle predates the war. The filing system predates the castle.
positive: Between us: the walls hold because the people holding them are paid, fed, and believed.
Walk the east rampart at dusk. Even a ledger has one beautiful page.
The keep's foundations were cut true a century back. We merely refuse to let them down.

negative: You ask the desert to describe its dunes. It buries surveyors.
The walls you see are the least of the walls. Be glad you see only these.
Maps of this place are sold cheap in every bazaar. All of them are wrong.
neutral: The castle is a well with towers. Everything else is ornament and patience.
We built where the water was and let the sand build everywhere else.
Stone above, cistern below, silence throughout. You have seen the whole of it.
positive: Come to the garden. A king who can keep a fig tree alive out here can keep a kingdom.
I will show you the cistern. It has outlasted four sieges and three of my moods.
The evening wind makes the towers sing. Stay, and hear my favorite argument for mercy.

negative: The war goes as wars go. Your part in it sits badly with me.
We trade men for ground and ground for time. What do you trade, I wonder.
Ask me again when your own account with us is settled.
neutral: The line holds. It always holds. The cost is the only news.
War is a quota like any other. This month we are ahead.
Winter fights for us. Summer fights for them. Autumn is honest work.
positive: Between friends: we will win because we can lose longer than they can.
The war eats. We feed it slower than the enemy does. That is strategy.
Good news is rationed like everything else. Today there is some.

negative: Operational matters are not shared with liabilities.
The war proceeds. Your conduct is a line item in it, and not on our side of the page.
Weapons-free is a sentence I have signed for less than what you have done.
neutral: Fronts stable. Supply adequate. Morale within parameters. Next question.
We do not narrate the war. We schedule it.
Setbacks logged, corrected, absorbed. The machine turns.
positive: Off the record: the enemy improvises beautifully. We do not improvise. We win.
The maps in the war room look better each quarter. I permit myself one smile per map.
We lead on every measure that matters and two that do not. I count all of them.

negative: The war is a fire you have carried wood to. Do not warm your hands here.
I do not discuss the storm with those who whistle for it.
The sand keeps the names it is given. Ask me nothing while yours is among them.
neutral: Armies cross the desert. The desert does not notice. We are the desert's memory.
They hold the roads. The roads hold nothing. We are content.
War in the open is theirs. War in the shade is ours. There is more shade than open.
positive: For you, the truth: we lose every battle they can find and win every one they cannot.
Patience is a blade that never needs the grindstone. Ours is very old and very sharp.
The enemy counts our tents and laughs. He has never once counted the wells.

negative: My people are not a spectacle. Mind your eyes.
They work. They would work easier if your shadow left the yard.
The line feeds them and they feed the line. You are outside both.
neutral: Everyone here has a quota. Even the king. Mine is worry.
They dig, they forge, they marry, they dig again. It is a life. It is ours.
Count the chimneys. Every one lit is a family the war has not won against.
positive: Ask the smiths to show you the school they built. I bragged about it for a month, quietly.
My people are stubborn as frost and twice as patient. I am their king because I noticed.
We bury too many and we sing too rarely. But the bread is real and no one eats alone.

negative: The census is confidential. The exits are well marked.
My citizens are assets under protection. From, at present, you.
They are fed, housed, and warned about strangers. The warnings have your outline.
neutral: Population stable. Rations balanced. Grievances filed and heard on Thursdays.
Each district reports, each report is read. Kingship is mostly reading.
They keep the walls; the walls keep them. The arrangement is audited yearly.
positive: Visit the lower market. Order that no one has to enforce — that is my proudest asset.
A realm is people plus procedure. Ours have made the procedure kind.
The choir practices on Thursdays. Attendance is voluntary and total. Doctrine cannot explain it.

negative: My people are the dunes. Count them, and they will have moved by morning.
Ask the vulture why it circles before you ask a king about his flock.
They see you more clearly than you see them. Be troubled by that.
neutral: By day they trade and tend. By night they are the reason the desert has ears.
A people is a river that learned to hide. Mine hides well and arrives everywhere.
They ask little of me: water, judgment, and that I never sell the shade.
positive: Walk the souk at dusk and taste what is offered. My treasury is that no one will let you pay.
My people gave me this throne twice. Once in war, once in peace. The second gift weighs more.
Every child here knows three wells and one song. The song mocks me gently. I keep it.

negative: My counsel: settle what you owe the line. Then we speak of futures.
Advice is for allies. Bring proof you are one.
Dig yourself out of the hole you dug with us. That is the whole of my wisdom for you.
neutral: Hold something. A wall, a word, a friend's flank. Holding is the whole trade.
Spend yourself slowly. The war is long and men are not.
Learn to be cold without being cruel. Most learn neither.
positive: Guard the small things. Big things are only small things that held.
Find work that outlives the winter. Then do it every winter.
You have a strong back and a decent name. Lend both where they are thanked.

negative: Guidance is issued to those in compliance. You are advised of that, and only that.
My counsel is corrective: stop. You know precisely what.
Begin with restitution. The ledger will consider a second page.
neutral: Verify before trusting. File what you learn. Doctrine in eight words.
Choose a sector and be answerable for it. Responsibility is the fastest promotion.
Precision, then speed, then courage. In that order. Courage first is how boys die.
positive: Take the border road, learn its gaps, and report them. The realm pays attention, and debts.
Keep your word to small people. Kings and clerks both keep records of that.
Train your eye before your arm. The arm follows a schooled eye anywhere.

negative: Counsel is water. I do not pour it into cracked jars.
First mend what you broke. The desert forgives nothing it has not watched repaired.
Seek wisdom elsewhere while your name dries out here.
neutral: Walk slower than your fear and faster than your pride. Most trouble misses such a walker.
Own a rope, a friend, and a debt you intend to pay. More than that is baggage.
When lost, sit. The desert rearranges itself for the patient.
positive: Plant something. A man with a tree argues differently about the future.
Keep one promise past the point it costs you. After that, all doors know your knock.
Drink before you are thirsty, forgive before you are asked. The rest is footwork.

negative: Bold words in a warm room. The cold outside has heard bolder.
Eleven kings before me heard such talk. The talkers are buried in even rows.
Say it again outside the wall. The wind argues back harder than I do.
neutral: Thrones outlast opinions here. It is nearly all they do.
Noted. The quota does not care, and today I am the quota's man.
I have been threatened by winters. You are not a winter.
positive: From a friend, that is almost a joke. Almost. Have a drink and find the rest of it.
You earned one free insult with us. That was it. Spend the next more wisely.
The line laughs rarely. It is not laughing now. Mind your boots, friend.

negative: Threat catalogued. Response authorized. Your next move decides the paperwork.
You mistake patience for permission. The distinction is armed.
One more incident and the guards stop being ceremonial.
neutral: Sedition is a category, not a conversation. You are drifting toward the category.
The crown registers your opinion. The crown files it under noise.
The guards remain at ease. Remain worth that decision.
positive: I will assume the road made you rude. Water and a chair are behind you. Use both.
Friends may test the crown once. Consider it tested and the matter closed.
That cost you a page of goodwill. You had several. Now you have several minus one.

negative: The sand has swallowed prouder sentences. It is always hungry.
Insult the well and thirst keeps the score. I need do nothing.
You speak loudly for a man standing where echoes have owners.
neutral: A king who fears words has already lost his wells. Mine are safe. Speak on.
The tent flap is behind you. The desert enjoys debates.
I decline to be wounded. Apply elsewhere.
positive: From you I will call that thirst talking. Sit. Drink. Try again as yourself.
Even the fig tree drops one bitter fruit. I will not judge the tree.
Careful, friend. The desert repeats what it hears, and its memory is excellent.

negative: Go. The door is the kindest thing I own for you today.
Leave the way you came. Straighter, if possible.
The cold will walk you out.
neutral: Go well. Dig deep, wherever they put you.
The line is long and you are keeping someone from it. Good day.
Mind the ice on the causeway. It has opinions.
positive: Come back before the stove goes out. It rarely does.
Travel as if a quota is waiting. For you, one always will be.
Go warm, friend of the line. That is the best blessing Vostok issues.

negative: Dismissed. The escort is not optional.
This audience is concluded and annotated. Study the annotation.
The exit is that way. Compliance is the other courtesy expected.
neutral: Audience concluded. The doors are marked. Good day.
You are released to your own schedule. Keep it clear of ours.
Dismissed in good order. The realm resumes.
positive: Safe roads. Report anything broken and anyone brave. Both interest me.
Go with the realm's regard. It is bankable in every district.
Until the next audience. The short list keeps your name.

negative: Go. May the road teach you what I declined to.
The desert will finish this conversation better than I can.
Take your shadow with you. We have enough of our own.
neutral: Go with water. Everything else is negotiable.
May your rope be long and your questions shorter next time.
The dunes will point your way home. They rarely lie twice.
positive: Go as a friend of the shade. Every well between here and the sea will know it.
Peace on your road, and figs when you return. Both are promised.
Carry my greeting to the horizon. It owes me several.
